description: Three representative acceptance notes: the same notes exposed as sample buttons in the UI and printed by scripts/demo.py. Each expected record is the documented output the demo is checked against.

cases.name: knee_canonical
cases.text: Right knee pain rated 6 out of 10, constant for three weeks. Worse with climbing stairs. Rest helps. Knee flexion is limited to 95 degrees. Quadriceps weakness. Prescribed straight leg raises and clamshells.

cases.name: shoulder_reversed_rom
cases.text: Bilateral rotator cuff pain 7/10. Overhead reaching aggravates it. ROM: 90 deg external rotation, shoulder. Rotator cuff muscles weakness. Advised wall slides and band pull aparts.

cases.name: lower_back_qualitative
cases.text: Lower back pain 4-5/10 for two months, intermittent. Aggravated by prolonged sitting, better with walking. Lumbar flexion is reduced. Gluteal tightness. Prescribed bird dog, dead bug and glute bridge.
